title: The reeve (wants the barrow sealed) and the gray priest (wants it open, and grants a blessing to that effect) never cross-reference each other's request even after I'd clearly sided with one — asking the priest for a blessing produced no 'the reeve won't like this' acknowledgment, and vice versa.

evidence.quote: The reeve (wants the barrow sealed) and the gray priest (wants it open, and grants a blessing to that effect) never cross-reference each other's request even after I'd clearly sided with one — asking the priest for a blessing produced no 'the reeve won't like this' acknowledgment, and vice versa.

The reeve (wants the barrow sealed) and the gray priest (wants it open, and grants a blessing to that effect) never cross-reference each other's request even after I'd clearly sided with one — asking the priest for a blessing produced no 'the reeve won't like this' acknowledgment, and vice versa.
